title: Interior and comfort evolution in the Mini
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: The Mini interior moved from sparse practicality toward more equipment, without losing its compact driving position.
content:
The Mini interior changed slowly because the basic body left little spare room. Early cars were simple and functional; later cars added trim, instruments, improved seats and more equipment without becoming large or isolated.

Practical final checks

Exterior details are covered in Mini exterior changes. The broader classic-to-modern comparison appears in what was kept or lost.

Sources

  • BMW Group PressClub, Classic Mini Timeline: 1959 - 2000
  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
